$comment2: displayClaims MUST include email: the order-lookup gate resolves the customer's VERIFIED email from the projected display claims and refuses with no_verified_email otherwise — an email a visitor types is not verified, so it is deliberately the only source. The key is clockSkewSeconds, NOT clockToleranceSeconds: the published config is a zod strictObject, so one unknown key makes the WHOLE config unparseable and every /support/<slug> render 404s while publish_tenant_runtime still answers ok.
$comment: Publishing REPLACES the workspace config, so this is the WHOLE of it — sites/_shared/publish/build-publish.mjs folds brand.json, demo.json and knowledge.json into one payload and nothing is ever published piecemeal.
